intentEvidence: The original intention is to use the ink screen device, because there will be residual shadows because of normal pages
motivation: The author built it for e-ink screen devices, where normal paging produces residual shadows.
problem: Normal page scrolling in Obsidian leaves ghosting residue on e-ink displays, and there are no on-screen controls for coarse page jumps.
summary: Adds four buttons for page up, page down, jump to top, and jump to bottom, designed for e-ink screen devices.
